style: Polished minimalist flat-vector illustration for a premium indie mobile game. Clean geometric shapes, subtle depth through layered planes and soft shadows, restrained detail, no outlines except where needed. Palette limited to warm ivory #FAF9F6, blue #3678D4, dark navy #202D40, muted sage #A9B9A1, brick red #B94E43, slate grey #737B82 and light cream #F1E8D8. Soft overcast English daylight. No gradients, no photorealism, no 3D, no texture noise, no watermark, no text except where quoted.
coco: Coco, a small African Grey parrot: rounded charcoal-grey body, slightly lighter grey wing, a distinctive brick-red tail, and a small simple curved dark beak. His head is a smooth plain grey sphere with only the beak on it, and no other facial features at all. No clothing or accessories. He is small in the frame, perched naturally as part of the scene.
people: Any people are simple faceless flat-vector figures with smooth blank faces, natural proportions, clothing and gesture carrying the role.
reference: Character reference sheet on a plain ivory background showing Coco the parrot from three angles: side view perched, three-quarter view with head tilted, and back view showing the red tail. Same design in every view.

scenes.airport: A modern British airport arrivals hall. Immigration booths with faceless officers, a traveller holding a passport, red queue-barrier tape on navy stanchions, a large window onto the apron with a plane tail, a navy hanging sign reading "Arrivals". Coco stands on the extendable handle of a blue suitcase in the foreground right, head tilted with curiosity.
scenes.taxi: A London street of brick Georgian townhouses with sash windows and coloured doors, a black London taxi on the road, a red pillar postbox, a black lamppost, pale overcast sky. Coco perched on a stone balustrade in the foreground right.
scenes.cafe: A cosy English café with warm wood floor, sage wainscot, a large window onto a brick street, a chalkboard menu reading "Menu", a counter with a faceless server and a glass cake dome, a round table set with a teapot and cup. Coco sits on the back rail of an empty wooden chair in the foreground right, body turned toward the table.
scenes.hotel: A welcoming British guesthouse reception. Wooden reception desk, a wall board of room keys, framed pictures, a faceless receptionist in a navy blazer, a hand bell, a potted plant, a navy suitcase. Warm cream, muted green and natural wood. Coco stands small on the end edge of the reception counter.
scenes.landmark: A grand English stone museum with a columned portico and pediment, a small ticket kiosk with a sign reading "Tickets", three faceless visitors, a tree, soft daylight and a pale sun. Coco lands on the stone railing in the foreground right.
scenes.street: A charming English high street: brick shopfronts with striped awnings, a small park behind iron railings, a red double-decker bus, two faceless pedestrians, a zebra crossing. In the foreground a navy street-sign post with signs reading "High Street" and "Station". Coco perched on the sign bracket with his head tilted, curious.
